notes:
What's new in Eliya Notes 1.8.1:
• Fixed the page flickering in split screen
• Drag any picture or drawing to move it anywhere on the page, even over text. Drag its right edge to make it bigger or smaller, double-click it to crop or edit
• Drawing on the page has a new ✋ move tool: grab any line you drew and move it
• The highlight on old notes now stops at the text
